ops-ana: FYI eu-west1 has a strange fsync/congestion pattern on scratch NVMEs, GPU attaches are timing out ~120s. small-write storm + scrub overlap.
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=eu-west1 metric=nvme_fsync_rate change=+340% window=6m
samir: sample iostat from gnode-4892 shows high await and %util near 100% on nvme0n1. can we get nvme top / queue stats?
marta: scrub backlog spiked at 02:10 UTC and an ephemeral cleanup kicked at 02:12. looks like two workloads collided.
oncall: propose a 3-node canary pause of janitor and temporarily route new GPU attaches to us-central to avoid attach churn. anyone opposed?
ryan: note cost impact for cross-region: will track in INFRA-7452. prefer minimal reroute window (15m).
ops-ana: pausing janitor on canary nodes now (gnode-489{2,4,7}) and routing attaches for 12m. will monitor pending-attach queue and nvme qdepth.
ops-ana: 02:18 update: qdepth on canary dropped from ~95% -> ~52%, pending attaches 34 -> 6. will keep routing for 10 more minutes then re-enable with reduced scrub concurrency.
marta: cutting a quick config change to scrub_concurrency per-region and add a guard that avoids starting scrubs if ephemeral_delete_rate > threshold.
ops-ana: INF-3311 created to track post-mortem and follow-ups.
